description: Haval Pakistan supply chain with 20 suppliers: 15 China-based Haval component manufacturers (Tier 1/2) and 5 Haval Pakistan local operations (Tier 2/3). Tracks automotive suppliers with performance metrics, delivery reliability, and quality ratings.
common_use_cases: Find top suppliers by total spend
Identify underperforming suppliers (low OTD or quality ratings)
Compare Haval Pakistan local operations vs China suppliers
Analyze supplier concentration by country or tier
Evaluate China Tier 1/2 vs Pakistan local sourcing mix

columns.name: supplier_name
examples: Qingdao CSD Auto And Equipment Co., Ltd.

columns.name: country
columns.business_rule: China suppliers are Haval component manufacturers (Tier 1/2); Pakistan suppliers are Haval-branded local operations (Tier 2/3) for assembly, parts distribution, and services

columns.name: supplier_tier
columns.description: Supplier tier classification in automotive supply chain
columns.business_rule: Tier 1 = China critical system suppliers (CATL, Great Wall Motors Powertrain, Yanfeng, Huayu); Tier 2 = China component suppliers + Haval Pakistan operations; Tier 3 = Haval Pakistan local service networks

columns.name: on_time_delivery_rate
columns.description: Percentage of deliveries completed on time (0-100)

columns.name: total_orders
columns.description: Total number of purchase orders placed

columns.name: total_spend_usd
columns.description: Total procurement spend with supplier in USD

relationships.description: One supplier receives many purchase orders

business_rules: Only Active suppliers should receive new orders
OTD rate below 90% triggers supplier review
Quality rating below 4.0 triggers quality improvement plan
Contract renewal review starts 90 days before expiration
sample_queries: SELECT supplier_name, total_spend_usd FROM Suppliers ORDER BY total_spend_usd DESC LIMIT 5
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Suppliers WHERE status='Active'
SELECT country, COUNT(*) as supplier_count FROM Suppliers GROUP BY country
SELECT supplier_name FROM Suppliers WHERE on_time_delivery_rate < 93
